messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: ctmm winter webinar
parts:
Dear community,

There will be a 1-hour webinar on both basic features (variograms & AKDE) and newer features in ctmm at the end of this month, followed by a question-and-answer session. You can vote on the schedule here:

https://doodle.com/meeting/participate/id/e5Q6JrAe

The webinar will take place on Zoom. A registration link will be provided when the date is set.

Best,
Chris

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: ctmm winter webinar
parts:
The ctmm winter webinar will be held via Zoom meeting on January 23, 9-11 AM Eastern Time (US and Canada).

Register in advance for this meeting: https://umd.zoom.us/meeting/register/tJEvd-ivrjoiGtVRP2TsFkiHPhkcxxYa5z5o

After registering, you will receive a confirmation email containing information about joining the meeting. Feel free to share the link and meeting password with others.

We will be using the ctmmlearn scripts and data, which you can download from Github: https://github.com/ctmm-initiative/ctmmlearn

The meeting will be recorded and a link will be posted afterwards.

Best,
Chris
